leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that creates a deep copy of primitive values
Construct logic to handle different data types during cloning
Apply recursion to clone nested objects and arrays
Initialize a new object or array structure for each cloned level
Manipulate object properties to populate cloned structures
Control circular reference detection to prevent infinite recursion
Integrate type checking to determine appropriate cloning strategy
lessonTitle: Write a deep clone utility without libraries
